description: This file declares the HeartbeatProcedure class and its factory, which are responsible for managing heartbeat procedures in the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data members related to heartbeat handling, including a nested HeartbeatHandler class.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedureFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HeartbeatProcedure instances, implementing the IHeartbeatProcedureFactory interface.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Implements the heartbeat logic, manages heartbeat handlers, and tracks heartbeat status.

classes.name: HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Nested class within HeartbeatProcedure that handles individual heartbeat events and callbacks.

methods.name: createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with the given acknowledgment sender and ping ID.

methods.name: createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new heartbeat handler for a specific control ID.

methods.name: pingSent
methods.description: Callback invoked when a ping has been sent.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Callback invoked when an error occurs in the heartbeat process.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the heartbeat.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Internal method called when a heartbeat starts.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Internal method called when a heartbeat finishes, with success status.
